licensing.distributionCategory: Generated WAV outputs only; model weights and runtime are not distributed with Menagerie.

events.role: Tiny bright porcelain contacts for quiet settling
events.prompt: One isolated light touch between two miniature thin-walled glazed porcelain ornaments. Crisp bright ceramic click followed by a clear, gently pitched hollow ring with delicate musical overtones and a natural 500 to 650 millisecond decay. Close, dry studio recording with minimal room sound and no washy reverb.

events.role: Clear hollow clinks for ordinary animal-to-animal contact
events.prompt: One isolated gentle clink between two miniature hollow glazed porcelain figurines. Crisp ceramic attack followed by a warm, resonant hollow tone with subtle musical overtones and a natural 700 to 900 millisecond decay. Close, dry studio recording with minimal room sound and no washy reverb.
